articles.title: India dispatches medical contingent to Venezuela amid earthquake crisis
articles.summary: The Indian Army has dispatched a specialised medical contingent from its 60 Para unit to earthquake-ravaged Venezuela. This humanitarian mission includes medical equipment and essential relief supplies, demonstrating India's commitment to international disaster relief. This initiative highlights the Indian Armed Forces' capability for rapid global deployment and their significant role in humanitarian assistance, beyond traditional defence operations.

articles.title: Forget Hormuz. The Shadow Fleet Is The Next Maritime Crisis.
articles.summary: The oil tanker 'Grinch', suspected of belonging to Russia's shadow fleet, was surveilled off the coast of Martigues, France, near Marseille-Fos on January 25, 2026. This event underscores the persistent international challenges in monitoring vessels potentially involved in sanctions evasion and illicit maritime activities. For an SSB aspirant, it highlights critical issues of global energy security, maritime surveillance, and geopolitical tensions impacting international trade and law.
